tasks.description: Categorize aqi_uk values into descriptive bands (Good, Fair, Poor, Very Poor) using UK DEFRA standards to provide intuitive air quality assessment.
Identify peak pollution hours by calculating hourly average AQI values and detecting time periods with consistently high pollution levels.
Map AQI bands to health risk levels (Low/Moderate/High/Very High) with corresponding advisories for sensitive groups based on UK health guidelines.
Calculate PM2.5/PM10 ratio for each reading to indicate pollution source patterns (e.g., combustion vs. dust sources).
